variants.interpretation: Exploratory fixed-policy prospective comparison. All arms spend 600 yen per included race; ST arms share the same six-ST eligibility. No automatic best-arm selection or production promotion.

drift.policy: first 200 fixed reference; latest 100 non-overlapping observations; PSI warning at 0.20; monitoring only
drift.interpretation: Changes can reflect venue or race mix; do not automatically retrain or change bets.

realtime.interpretation: Only observed pre-close changes are stored. Final paired scoring uses the last valid snapshot; cancelled races are excluded.

baseline.event: highest-score trifecta combination hits; one observation per race

candidate.event: highest-score trifecta combination hits; one observation per race

paired_intervals.method: 1000 paired bootstrap samples of whole date blocks; 95% percentile interval
paired_intervals.direction: candidate minus baseline; negative log loss/Brier is better, positive hit rate/ROI is better
paired_intervals.limitation: Exploratory monitoring only; intervals do not adjust for repeated inspection or candidate selection.

diagnostics.promotion: No automatic production promotion. Future chronological holdout evaluation is still required.

interpretation: Prospective paired shadow evaluation. No historical reconstruction or production promotion.

health.limitation: A report is refreshed only when the workflow runs; this alone cannot detect a completely stopped scheduler. No external notifications are sent.

collection_daily.limitation: Unrecorded closed races are coverage gaps, not proof of collector failure. Historical program denominators are unknown. Cancelled and excluded records are separate. No predictions reconstructed.

st_diagnostics.limitation: Negative ST is excluded by the existing comparison policy. Missing historical values do not establish whether data was unpublished or fetching failed. Predictions and policies are unchanged.

learning_inputs.interpretation: Prospective registration-number and dated features for later training. Older records are not retrofitted. Missing preclose course stays null.

odds_diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive saved preclose snapshots only. Six equal and saved baseline EV are separate shadow scopes. Hit rate is per ticket, not per race. Actual payout uses official result; expected return uses saved odds and uncalibrated probability. Full 120-odds coverage required for a common cohort; counts show exclusions. Tickets within a race are dependent. No fitting, new forecasts, rule changes or promotion.

odds_deterioration.interpretation: Read-only decomposition using original saved selections. Saved-odds realized payout uses observed hits and preclose odds, not a new forecast or claim that odds were locked. Actual minus saved-odds realized return measures payout movement on winning tickets. Saved-odds realized minus estimated return mixes probability error, selection and sampling noise; it does not identify causal calibration error. Losing-ticket final odds cannot be recovered from official payouts. Winning-only ratios cannot establish a universal odds haircut. No fitting, retrospective bets or promotion.

odds_calibration.interpretation: Fit once on first20 completed past dates with >=500 complete preclose-odds races. Freeze persisted model; compare only snapshots captured after fitting, never retrofit completed races. Same saved odds and fixed EV policy. Five future dates and >=150 paired settled races required for review. No automatic production adoption.

robust_ev.interpretation: Fixed calibrated EV comparison, same eligible races and 400 yen maximum per race. Additional 10% probability and 10% odds reductions are hypothetical stress scenarios, not statistical confidence bounds. Use actual settled payouts. Never retrofit missing captures or auto-promote.

conservative_ev.interpretation: Prospective fixed rules on the same preclose-captured races; skips count as profit 0. Reaching the review point is not adoption. Zero purchases are reported as a result, never relaxed. Bootstrap shares are shares of resamples, not probabilities of future loss.

selection_diagnostics.limitation: Fixed descriptive bins overlap across axes. Unknown saved inputs are not reconstructed. No filter fitting, rule changes, or production promotion; future chronological validation is required.

collection_gaps.limitation: Only observed attempts establish a failure reason. No observation cannot distinguish collection start time, missed scheduling, or unavailable input. Historical predictions are never reconstructed.
